TOBACCO, (PURCHASE BY MANUFACTURERS) RULES, 1972,
TOBACCO, (PURCHASE BY MANUFACTURERS) RULES, 1972,
[Gazette of Pakistan. Extraordinary, 29th August 1972]
S. R. O. 662(1)/72.-In exercise of the' powers conferred by
section 30 .of the Pakistan Tobacco Board Ordinance, 1968 (1 of 1968), the
Central Government is pleased to make the following rules, namely ;.-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) These rules may be called
the Tobacco (Purchase by Manufacturer) Rules, 1972.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.-In these rules, unless there is anything repugnant
in the subject or context,-
(a) "Centrally Administered Areas" has the same meaning
as in the Province of West Pakistan (Dissolution) Order,-1970.(P. O. No. 1 of
1970); 1.
(b) "Ordinance" means the Pakistan Tobacco Board Ordinance,
1968 (I of 1968) ; and
(c) "Tobacco Season" means the year commencing on the
first day of July and ending on the thirtieth day of June.
3. Order under section 20J-A of Ordinance when to be made.-----An
order under section 20-A of the Ordinance may be made by the Central Government
if ft is satisfied that, due to abnormal circumstances, there is a likelihood
of such excessive fluctuation in the production of tobacco in any tobacco
season ,as compared to Its production in the immediately preceding season as
may have an adverse effect on the interests of the growers of tobacco.
4. Determination of total quantity to be purchased,.-Where the
Central Government intends to make an order under section 20-A of the
Ordinance, ft shall first determine the total quantity of tobacco to be
purchased, by the manufacturers during a specified tobacco season, having due
regard to the need to avoid excessive fluctuation in the output of tobacco,
from year to year, as well as the desirability of maintaining a balance, in the
long-run, between the supply and demand of tobacco.
5. Allocation to each manufacturer.-The total quantity as
determined under rule 4 shall be allocated among the manufacturers pro rata on
the basis of the aggregate of the quantity of cigarettes sold by each
manufacturer in the Provinces of Baluchistan. the North-West Frontier, the
Punjab, and Sind and the Centrally Administered Areas during the twelve months
period ending the 30th June immediately preceding the date of orders and the
quantity of tobacco actually exported by the manufacturer in the same period.
6. Following the allocation made under rule 5 the Central
Government may direct a manufacturer to take such steps as may be necessary to
ensure the purchase of the requisite quantity of tobacco, at the appropriate
time.
